integrity: The group-theoretic structure is derived directly from the dihedral presentation. The Laplacian spectrum follows from the complete-split decomposition; spanning trees and Kirchhoff index then follow from standard spectral identities.
scientific_limitations: The result is for the noncyclic graph, not the noncommuting graph.
No extension to generalized quaternion, semidihedral, or arbitrary metacyclic groups is claimed.
The finite checker covers 3<=n<=8 only; the general result is proved symbolically.
title: Laplacian spectrum and tree complexity of the dihedral noncyclic graph
